description: This file defines an internal sealed class 'GrainDirectoryPartitionSnapshot' which represents a snapshot of a grain directory partition, including its membership version and a list of grain addresses.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryPartitionSnapshot
classes.description: An immutable class that encapsulates the membership version and list of grain addresses for a grain directory partition snapshot.

methods.name: GrainAddresses
